title: Private Peacock Bass Fishing Charter Near Miami Beach
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 4 people per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Few places in the world offer the opportunity to catch exotic butterfly peacock bass within minutes of a major international city. Unlike traditional freshwater fishing trips, this private charter combines world-class sportfishing with the energy and scenery of urban Miami, creating an experience found nowhere else in Florida. 

Your licensed captain customizes every trip to your group's experience level while providing premium rods, reels, tackle, and expert local guidance. 

Whether you're chasing your first peacock bass or searching for a trophy catch, you'll enjoy calm freshwater conditions, incredible photo opportunities, and easy access from Miami Beach, Downtown, and the airport—all without spending hours traveling to your destination.
